scope: Contemporary CMB comparison added after primary-source acquisition identified the actual multi-experiment combination; declared before sampling this target.
relationship_to_original: The original full-Planck2018 + DESIDR2 + Dovekie chain and its support remain distinct. The contemporary combination is explicitly specified in external_probes/modern_adapter.py and is not labelled exact author reproduction.
calibration: Baseline official_planck: A_act=A_planck; alternate paper_literal: A_act=P_act. Public author runtime configuration remains separately audited; paper prose and released chain headers are not silently conflated.
background: Same flat FLRW, GR, PPF, neutrino, primordial and recombination assumptions as the original design, with modern-adapter numerical accuracy settings. CAMB's implicit w0+wa<=0 support is retained and disclosed.
numerical_proposal: A frozen polynomial interpolation of CAMB spectra may accelerate proposal sampling. It is not data, a cosmological prior, or the final target. Background quantities are calculated separately with CAMB. Outside the documented interpolation envelope the proposal evaluates CAMB directly.
validation: Exact provider interface must close against native Cobaya/CAMB at reference and independent physical points. Fit only training spectra. Evaluate independent held-out likelihood errors without fitting to holdout rows. Posterior samples require independent-chain Rhat<=1.01 and bulk/tail ESS>=400, including calibration nuisance parameters.
exact_correction: Select at least 2000 stratified posterior points across four independent converged proposal chains; evaluate the native exact CAMB likelihood at each. Use untrimmed importance weights proportional to exp(log posterior exact - log posterior proposal). Report raw importance ESS, Pareto k, largest weight, weighted Monte Carlo stability and chain-specific agreement. Require weight ESS>=400 and Pareto k<0.7; enlarge sampling or revise the numerical proposal if these gates fail.
limitation: Finite importance diagnostics test overlap in the sampled region and cannot prove that no remote mode was missed. Retain broad priors, domain failures, independent starts and the direct older-CMB reference. No evidence ratio follows from these calculations.
physical_scope: This remains a released-distance cosmological measurement, conditional on the upstream supernova correction/covariance and the stated inter-probe dependence approximation. Unidentified host-age physics is not converted into a measured correction.

pre_heldout_numerical_amendment_2026_09_.reason: The full training cohort is now complete; the earlier 330-row and slow-lensing sampler outputs are engineering pilots only. No held-out spectrum errors were inspected when choosing the final training fit.
pre_heldout_numerical_amendment_2026_09_.training: Cubic polynomial, all 509 finite training rows, 165 coefficients per spectral output. Three prior-invalid attempts retained separately. Heldout remains untouched.
pre_heldout_numerical_amendment_2026_09_.lensing: Exact prebinning of fixed linear response matrices, independently verified to rounding precision; no observed values, covariance, response term or theoretical spectrum changed. Explicit modern_fast wrapper.
pre_heldout_numerical_amendment_2026_09_.sampling: Four independent correlated Metropolis chains. Published posterior covariance and mean only initialize proposals and starts; unchanged declared priors. Exact posterior correction and original convergence gates remain mandatory.

sampler_cost_amendment_2026_09_27T1142Z.change: Fresh four-chain Metropolis run with proposal scale1.6; no change to the proposal density, physical target, envelope4, source parameters or data. Scale2.4pilot preserved and excluded from posterior.
sampler_cost_amendment_2026_09_27T1142Z.basis: A fixed-centre paired diagnostic using native Cobaya proposal directions found5/192 envelope fallbacks atscale2.4,1/192 atscale1.6 and0/192 atscale1.2. No spectral negativity. This is a cost diagnostic, not a measured ESS or acceptance comparison.
sampler_cost_amendment_2026_09_27T1142Z.selection: Scale1.6 chosen for lower expected fallback cost without narrowing as far as1.2. All original convergence and exact-correction gates remain unchanged.
